nom: medicube PDRN Pink Peptide Eye Serum

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive eyelids/skin report mixed results: one saw no sting and found it simply moisturizing with no extra benefit, while others report dryness, redness, and bags forming under the eyes.
segments.mature: Reviewers focused on fine lines and crepey under-eye skin report visible reduction in lines and firmer, brighter-looking skin over a few uses to two weeks.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers report diminished fine lines, firmer and brighter under-eyes, and less crepey skin, in some cases after only two weeks; one reviewer used six weeks with zero visible results.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the product as hydrating and moisturizing with lasting effect through the day; however, two reviewers report the opposite, saying it dried out the under-eye area.
concerns.redness: Two reviewers report the product caused new redness on the cheeks or under the eyes, describing it as the opposite of soothing.
concerns.barrier: Two reviewers describe reactions consistent with barrier irritation, including possible chemical burns and increased lines from dryness; most other reviewers report no such reaction.

aspects.libelle: Causes dryness and bags for some users

extraits.texte: I have been using it for 3 days. It has dried out the skin under my eyes causing more lines, turned my cheeks red and caused a bag under my right eye. I have never had anything like this happen before
I've used this product 3x and has done the complete opposite of olum and hydrate. It has just caused redness, dryness and possible chemical burns :(
This cream doesnt sting my eyes or cause any reaction (i have very sensitive eyelids, so that is a plus). It is moisturizing and works just fine, it just doesnt have any other benefits.

extraits.titre: I would buy this product again.
extraits.texte: It can be drying & can cause bags under your eyes if you have sensitive skin. I put a light layer of the serum on & follow it with the CeraVe eye repair cream to combat the negative effects I experienced. So far it seems to be a great combination.

This is the best eye cream. The way it has brightened and hydrated my eyes in only 2 weeks. My very fine lines have diminished and i feel like my eyes dont look as tired amd dull. I have even started using around my laugh lines and notice a difference.
This has taken my dryer creapy , fine lines under my eyes and really changed them for the better. very hydrating but light weight lays well under concealer / makeup
Been using this cream consistently for 6 weeks now and no results, at all. Was holing to see at least something. Zero! Doesnt work for me. Im back on the market looking for another eye serum.
